player_prompt.intro:
I nɛ jɛkulu {player_id} o Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Anw tɛ se, i bɛna fɛ anw kɛ 'X' waati 'O' kɔnɔ kɛlɛ bɛɛ.
I taa anw kɛlɛ sɔrɔ anw kɛlɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔntɛ (X waati O) kɔnɔ kɛlɛ.
I bɛna fɛ anw kɛlɛ sɔrɔ anw kɛlɛ kɛlɛ.
O bɛn'a kɛlɛnden kɛlɛ '[X 4]' fɛ 'X' kɔnɔ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛlɛnden jɛkulu kɛlɛ sɔrɔ. Sɛbɛn '[X 4]' waati '[O 2]' kɛlɛ.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Seli man ɲi: {cell}. A ka kan ka kɛ 0 ni 8 cɛ.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Kolibali. Selili {cell} bɛ yen ka ban.

game_action.placed: Jɛkulu {player_id} yan jɛkulu kɛlɛ ({mark}) kɔnɔ kɛlɛ {cell}
